checks.claim: Brake fluid carries your push from a small piston at the pedal to bigger pistons at the wheel, multiplying the force about four to five times
checks.why: The study guide works 25.4 mm vs 54 mm pistons to about 4.5 times; HowStuffWorks confirms the principle.

checks.claim: Repeated hard stops from high speed can heat a brake disc past 500 degrees Celsius
checks.why: EngineerFix gives over 500 C for a very hard emergency stop or repeated stops from high speed; Kwik-Fit gives about 500 C on track.
